svg.text: Morning 9:00–12:30 · Afternoon 2:00–5:30 · Evening 7:30–10:00 · P1 = Must topics (in most papers), P2 = High · dark = exam · faded = light recall (sleep by 11)
Topics inside each block: _prep/plan/priority-blocks.md · files and pages: _prep/study-guide/ · rules: _prep/plan/schedule.md
CAD P1c · SQS, SNS, fan-out, SWF/SF
CAD P1d · 6 pillars, DMS, SMS, Snow
CAD P2a · EC2, ASG/ELB, storage, KMS
CAD P2b · WAF, Shield, cost, NACL, VPN
OS P1a · sched, Banker, disk, paging
OS P2b · classics, threads, paging bits
AI P2 · DFS/BFS, GA, HC/SA, logic
ACC P1 · Java I/O, arrays, sieve
CN P1a · M1–3: delay, CRC, MAC
CD P2b · reg. alloc, codegen, Lex
Also: one Java (ACC) program a day as a 30-minute warm-up. Do P1 before P2. If you fall behind, cut the P2 topics of the next block, never P1.
